 Ex No.786/18
 Paramjit Kaur & Ors. Vs. Santra Devi & Ors.
15.04.2023
 Order

Vide this order, the Court shall dispose off the objections of DDA as per the liberty granted by the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi in Ex. FA No.2/20 vide its order dated 25.10.2021 to the objector Delhi Development Authority (hereinafter called as DDA).
Pursuant to that order, on 20.12.2021 DDA filed its objection under section 47 r/w section 151 CPC in the present execution petition alongwith documents.

2. DDA in its objection petition has taken the following objections:-
2.1) DHs as well as JDs did not approach the Executing Court as well as Trial Court with clean hand and suppressed the material facts regarding the acquisition of the suit property way back in the year 1969 and that the suit property belonged to DDA.
2.2) DDA was deliberately not made party in the main suit bearing CS no.174/14 titled as "Paramjeet Kaur & Ors. Vs. Santa Devi & Ors." before the Trial Court.

sentences.text: If DDA was impleaded as a party to the suit, the fate of the suit would have been different.

2.3) DDA, being defendant no.3, had filed its written statement in a Civil Suit for declaration and permanent bearing CS no.141/18 titled as "Hem Prakash Vs.
Paramjeet Kaur & Ors" wherein it contended that the land of Khasra No.1 etc. / 41 (0-4 Biswa) & 1 etc./ 42/2 (36 Bigha-13 Biswa) of village Ghonda Chauhan Bangar was acquired vide award no.4/1969 and after acquisition, the possession of the land 0-4 Biswa of Khasra No.1 etc. /41 and land measuring 36 Bigha of Khasra No. 1 etc. /
42 /2 was handed over to DDA by LAC / L&B on 27.06.1969. Further for its development, it was placed at the disposal of DDA vide Notification No. F8(49) 63 /
L&H dated 01.02.1972 issued under the provision of Section 22(1) of Delhi Development Act, 1957.

Paramjeet Kaur & Ors

sentences.text: The suit property forms part of the acquired land and physical possession of which was handed over to DDA by LAC / L&B.
Therefore, any kind of sale and purchase in respect of government land is absolutely illegal and of no consequences and construction raised therein is absolutely illegal and unauthorized.

As such, none has got any right, title, or interest over the suit property except DDA.
2.4)
DHs as well as JDs have also no right, title or interest over the suit property.
The decree dated 15.07.2014 has become inexecutable and therefore, the present execution petition is not maintainable and is liable to be dismissed.

DHs submitted the following arguments by way of reply : -
3.1) Objections of DDA are abuse of process of law; there is no ground made out for interference in the Judgment and Decree dated 15.07.2014.
3.2) The executing court cannot go behind the decree.
No such objections were ever raised by DDA during the pendency of the main suit bearing no.174/14.
Objections have been filed at the behest of JDs just to delay the execution proceedings.

3.3) The possession of 13 Biswa in village Ghonda Chauhan Khadar, out of the total land measuring 36 Bigha 13 Biswa in Khasra No.1 etc. / 42/2 situated in Village Ghonda Chauhan Khadar was acquired vide award no.4/1969 but its possession was never taken by LAC / L&B or handed over to DDA.
The said land presently falls in Shastri Park being property bearing no.H-39, Shastri Park, Delhi.

A notification was issued on 02.03.1987 for regularization of Shastri Park Colony and the entire Shastri Park Colony has been transferred to MCD (EDMC) vide office order No.3/bldg./HQ/87 dated 02.03.1987 issued by MCD, building Department (HQ),
Town Hall, Delhi.
However, the possession of the suit property was never taken under Section 16 of Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

Consequently, DDA has no right over the suit property as the acquisition proceedings lapsed in terms of section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: 3.4) DDA in its written statement filed in Civil Suit no.141/18 stated that the possession of the suit property was never taken due to built- up houses.
Thus, now DDA has no right to claim any right or possession over the suit property.

3.5) According to Khasra Girdawri and Khatauni, the suit property is still shown in the name of the original recorded owner being Shri Nathu, Shri Laxman, Shri Dharampal and Smt. Angoori and it never vested with the DDA.
3.6) The decree dated 15.07.2014 is still executable and the objections of DDA are not maintainable.
4. JD No.1 submitted the following arguments by way of reply :-
4.1) JD No.1 claims adverse possession over the suit property qua DDA for having been in unobstructed possession over 30 years since 1970 qua DHs for more than 12 years.
JDs have electricity bills, House Tax receipts and Water bills paid against the suit property showing long duration of actual and physical possession of JDs over the suit property.
The LC report also confirms the actual physical possession of JDs over the suit property.
The other families besides the family of JDs have also been residing for quite long time in the land measuring Paramjit Kaur & Ors. vs . Santra Devi & Ors.

(Civil Appeal No.7374/03 decided on 12th July, 2011.

sentences.text: 4.3) The acquired land in which the suit property falls is situated in Shastri Park Colony.
The said colony has been developed and is under regularization by the government which is also reflected in para no.15 of the Order dated 25.10.2021 passed by the Hon'ble High Court in Ex.F.A. 2/20.

4.4) The services and building activities of 155 unauthorized colonies including Shastri Park near Seelampur are with MCD (EDMC) in pursuance of office Order no.3 / bldg/HQ/87 dated 02.03.1987 issued by MCD, Building Department (HQ), Town Hall, Delhi.

In pursuance of the notification regarding consideration for regularization of Shastri Park Colony, the civil services have been taken over by MCD from DDA and as such the possession of JDs should not be disturbed.

4.5)
DDA was not a party to the main suit and the decree dated 15.07.2014 was not passed in favour of DDA.
DHs are not entitled for possession of the suit property and the decree dated 15.07.2014 is void, nullity and inexecutable.

4.6) As per record, Sh. Dharampal had received compensation from the government qua the suit property and therefore, he was no more the owner of the suit property and every document subsequently executed by Sh. Dharampal became void-ab initio and does not create any right in favour of DHs.
4.7) The decree dated 15.07.2014 may be refused to be executed being nullity and further the possession of JD over the suit property may not be disturbed.
Findings of the Court On perusal of record

, it is revealed in compliance of the Order dated 25.10.2021 passed by Hon'ble High Court of Delhi in Ex.F.A. 2/20, this court vide order dated 19.05.2022, issued warrants of possession of the suit property which were executed by the Bailiff on 06.04.2022 and keys of the suit property were deposited and directed to be kept in safe custody in a sealed condition.

It is further revealed that vide Order dated 25.10.2021, the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi in Ex.F.A.
No.2/20, declined to pass any order thereby going beyond the decree dated 15.07.2014, though the Hon'ble High Court stated that DDA was well within its right to raise objections which it may have qua DHs for being handed over the suit property pursuant the impugned judgment and decree and further granted liberty to DDA to file objections, if any, before this court, within 8 weeks from the date of order.

The Hon'ble High Court of Delhi also directed this court to adjudicate the objections of DDA, in accordance with law and only after adjudicating of the objection filed by DDA, this court would further proceed in the execution petition in respect of possession of the suit property.
The Hon'ble High Court of Delhi left the question as to whether DHs were entitled to the possession of the suit property, is to be considered by this Court.

The facts curved out after perusing the pleadings of the parties that the judgment and decree dated 15.07.2014 was passed in favour of DHs and against JDs vide which DHs were declared owner of the suit property and they were also entitled for possession from JDs.

It is factually correct that during the proceedings before the Trial Court, DDA was not a party to the suit and the parties to the suit never disclosed about the Acquisition Award no.4/69 , therefore, the DDA certainly has stake over the suit property.

Further, it is to be noted that one Sh. Hem Prakash had filed a suit bearing no.141/18 titled as "Hem Prakash Vs. Paramjeet Kaur & Ors"
in which the DDA was made party as defendant no.3 and DHs and JD No.1 were also a party to that suit.

entities.text: Hem Prakash Vs. Paramjeet Kaur & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: DDA had filed a written statement in that suit.

Therefore, on perusal of the plaint of that suit available on record, it can be assumed that DDA was having the knowledge about the judgment and decree dated 15.07.2014 and about the subsequent proceedings pending before the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi in respect of the judgment and decree dated 15.07.2014 but even thereafter, DDA never took any appropriate steps to challenge the said judgment and decree dated 15.07.2014 and only when the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi in Ex.F.A. 2/20 asked the DDA to join the proceedings and further granted liberty to file objections before this Court, the objections were filed by the DDA.
It is also not in dispute that the DDA was never in the possession of the suit property.

The approach of DDA appears to be very lenient but this court has to decide the objections of the DDA on merits , pursuant to the directions of the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi passed in Ex.FA. 2/20 vide its order dated 25.10.2021.

The question whether DHs are entitled for the possession of the suit property under the objections raised by the DDA and JD no.1 is to be adjudicated by this Court and if the answer to this question goes in negative then this Court also has to decide who would hold the possession of the suit property.
This court also has to adjudicate whether under the contentions raised by the parties whether the decree dated 15.07.2014 is still executable or not.

After perusing the factual matrix of this case and legal prepositions, this court has come to the conclusion that the objections of DDA cannot be adjudicated in a summary manner but it needs to be decided only through trial as the issues raised by all concerned are triable in nature.

The questions as to whether DHs are entitled for the possession of the suit property and the decree dated 15.07.2014 is executable in lieu of the contentions raised by DDA, are the questions which can be adjudicated only after leading evidence by the parties.

However, it is made clear that the contentions of JDs which have already been declined by Ld. Trial Court by passing judgment and decree dated 15.07.2014, cannot be reagitated by JD No.1 in trial before this Court in the present Execution Petition.
The parties shall be at liberty to Paramjit Kaur & Ors. vs . Santra Devi & Ors.
